$comment: PLAN-scope v5 §5.0 / v6: the declared order of the use-scope lane's Layer 2 rounds, as data. Each round commits prereg-<r>.json (the attribution probe's expected from -> to) in its (a) commit and actual-<r>.json (the production path, from the a_sha and b_sha trees) in its (b) commit. R1 (bylaw-use-scope.logic.test.ts) reads only prereg files: the last round with an actual asserts its to; a round with a prereg and no actual asserts its from. bylaw-use-scope-prereg.infra.test.ts locks that each prereg is touched by exactly one commit, a strict ancestor of the commit adding its actual (F2-r). Location: scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation (not scripts/seeds/bylaw, whose every file is hashed into the Layer 2 table_version, so a pre-registration there would itself move the inputs and unpin the CoA lock). The CoA halves are coa-expected/prereg-use-scope-<r>.json (the prereg-coa-2026-d.json precedent).
